items.item_text: 01. Select the career website you used to find this employment opportunity: Options: Sbccd.edu | Indeed.com | HigherEdJobs.com | EdJoin.org | CCCregistry.org | Other
02. Did you attach the required transcripts? Options: Yes | No

03. Which option below best describes your highest level of education? (NOTE: For positions requiring college units/degree, a copy of the transcript must be included as an attachment. The transcript must be legible from an accredited institution and include your name, the institution name and confer date). Options: Some High School | High School or G.E.D. | Some College | Associates Degree | Bachelors Degree | Masters Degree | Doctorate Degree | None

04. Describe your experience using data to identify and address equity gaps, particularly racial inequities, in an educational setting. Please provide a specific example of how you used data to identify a disparity and the actions you implemented to address it in areas such as classroom instruction, curriculum development, or shared governance. What measurable outcomes resulted from your efforts?
05. Describe your experience in the development or implementation of a competitive forensics program. Please use specific examples.
06. Describe specific teaching strategies you have implemented to promote student engagement, active learning, and positive student relationships. Please provide examples.
07. Describe your experience teaching asynchronous public speaking courses.

08. I hereby understand and declare that the statements on this supplemental questionnaire are true and complete to the best of my knowledge. As applicable, I hereby authorize the District and/or designees to contact the references listed to verify the information I have supplied. I hereby release from liability all persons and organizations furnishing such information. I understand that the District reserves the right to validate information received on the supplemental questionnaire and that I will be subject to disqualification and/or termination if any statement in this supplemental questionnaire is found to be untrue or determined to be misleading. Options: Yes | No
Experience in the development or implementation of a competitive forensics program.

Experience teaching asynchronous public speaking courses in a manner that prioritizes regular and substantive interaction, frequent student-to-student communication and delivery of speeches to live audiences.
Incorporate equitable teaching practices within all courses taught within the disciplines.
Teaching assigned courses in a manner consistent with academic professionalism, departmental standards, and course outlines of record.

Work collaboratively with faculty and others on curriculum design, program review, the development and implementation of a speech and debate program, and other departmental/program and college processes.

Develop, implement, and coordinate a competitive speech and debate (forensics) program, including recruiting students, coaching and mentoring participants, coordinating tournament participation and travel, managing the program budget, and assessing student learning and program effectiveness.
Assess student learning outcomes and plan for improvement.
Maintain and submit accurate records.
Actively participate in shared governance and individual faculty responsibility outside the classroom.
Maintain regular office hours in a timely manner.
Participate in required training to teach courses in a variety of modalities.
Participate in regular professional development activities.
Engage in campus and district activities.

Demonstrated knowledge of and willingness to take initiative to address inequities, especially racial inequities, through the use of data to identify and close equity gaps in all aspects of work, including building classroom community, developing curriculum, and participating in governance.
Demonstrated willingness and ability to apply student engagement techniques such as active learning, intrusive support, and maintaining positive student relations.
